'''2024 Online Retro Event for Charity''' was the Players Committee [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]] charity event on GEMP, 11 May – 6 July 2024. [[Patrick Lima]] finished 1st among the published lists.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v/ 2024-07 Online Retro Event for Charity – Classic No-V], starwarsccg.org. Snapshot: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v.html swccg.com]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014154847/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v.html Internet Archive, 14 October 2026]</ref>
